key_insight: Online reinforcement learning can improve generalist robot policies across diverse tasks and, with the right recipe, improve tasks absent from online training.
engineering_relevance: Multi-task adaptation offers a path to improving deployed robot foundation models without restricting optimization to a single task.
method: Develop structured evaluations of multi-task online improvement.
Compare value estimation, policy extraction, and resource allocation choices.
Examine how training-task distributions and value-based RL affect generalization.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports gains across diverse training tasks and tasks not used during online training, but provides no numerical results or evaluation scale.
watch_item: Generalization depends on the training-task distribution and RL recipe; improvement on unseen tasks should not be assumed.
paper_title: Reinforcement Learning Enables Scaling Generalist Robot Policy Improvement
